headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 6, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners secured a dominant 4-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Bryce Miller pitching 6.0 innings of shutout baseball. Dominic Canzone led the Mariners' offense with a 3-hit, 2-RBI performance, including his 8th home run of the season.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's availability. Quinn Priester, a right-hander for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right thoracic outlet syndrome. Tyler Glasnow, a right-hander for the Los Angeles Dodgers, has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to low back spasms. Austin Wells, a catcher for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to cervical headaches.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their bullpen with the acquisition of right-handed pitcher Joel Kuhnel in a trade with the Athletics for cash. The Los Angeles Angels traded catcher Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash. The Minnesota Twins traded right-hander Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Out Tigers 4-0**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a dominant 4-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Bryce Miller pitching 6.0 innings of shutout baseball. Dominic Canzone led the Mariners' offense with a 3-hit, 2-RBI performance, including his 8th home run of the season.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Twins in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals took down the Minnesota Twins 3-2, with Carter Jensen leading the offense and Matt Strahm earning the win.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in St. Louis**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 5-6 decision to the St. Louis Cardinals in a closely contested matchup. Matt McLain led the Reds' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Giants Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs edged the San Francisco Giants 3-2, securing a narrow victory. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with 4 hits, including 2 home runs, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers RHP Quinn Priester Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-hander Quinn Priester has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right thoracic outlet syndrome. This move is a status change for the team.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Bullpen with Kuhnel Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added right-handed pitcher Joel Kuhnel to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash. Kuhnel joins the Brewers' pitching staff.
